purpose: Evaluate the finite-sample consequences of Robust SIV weight learning and exposure estimation at T0=5 and T1=10 without changing the principal simulation design.

population_objective_bank.construction: For each branch, average the exact Q_Y, Q_W, and rho objects across independent T0=5 learning panels, then solve the constrained quadratic problem using the fixed DGP exposure vector.
population_objective_bank.interpretation: Finite-DGP population-objective benchmark; it is not asserted to equal the deterministic sequence in the asymptotic theorem.

weight_variants.robust_population_true_d: Fixed DGP exposure and population-objective Q blocks and rho.
weight_variants.robust_learned_q_true_d: Fixed DGP exposure and replication-specific learned Q blocks and rho.
weight_variants.robust_population_q_full_dhat: Full-window estimated exposure and population-objective Q blocks and rho.
weight_variants.robust_full_empirical: Full-window estimated exposure and replication-specific learned Q blocks and rho.
weight_variants.robust_reported_simulation: Learning-window estimated exposure and replication-specific learned Q blocks and rho; this is the reported simulation weighting rule.
weight_variants.tsls_true_d: TSLS weights formed from the fixed DGP exposure.
weight_variants.tsls_full_dhat: TSLS weights formed from the full-window estimated exposure.
weight_variants.tsls_learning_dhat: TSLS weights formed from the learning-window estimated exposure.
